guard: Managed run issuance requires independent current child scope and fresh direct-parent run grant, uses exact native signed ceiling and own lifecycle source, preserves interactive issuance and owner-confined manager workflows. A hosted helper's parent is the caller the issuing host observed asking for it, or the run's starter, and a run's helper also stays within what the starter held when the run was admitted. The loopback verify door a host platform asks decides the same parent and bound, answers a retry of the same enrollment again, and refuses another enrollment of the same observed spawn, another helper under the same digest included. A run's saved persona is owned by the run's starter.
